artStyle: Block City glossy voxel / ocean blue & gold
notes: Origin coordinates are normalized over full untrimmed PNG canvas.
Building origin is base-front contact point, not base centre; grid placement must account for diamond depth.
Non-animated city art represents completed buildings only.
Gem and heart are optional reference assets; do not add new mechanics just to use them.
Particles are static textures to animate with tweens/emitters.
